2608.30413.title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark
2608.30413.paper_summary: Defeasible reasoning is a type of reasoning where inferences are drawn from plausible current evidence, but can be retracted upon the introduction of newer evidence. Although recent studies have examined language-model behaviors in defeasible reasoning, the datasets have been static and lack wide coverage of non-monotonic reasoning categories. We introduce DeReLab, a generative framework that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations from parameterized graph structures across default and inheritance reasoning, with formally verified ground truth at every turn, enabling controlled measurement of how models respond to confirming and disconfirming evidence. This controlled generation process creates a testbed for experimental designs that isolate specific reasoning demands. Applying this capability to the study of confirmation bias, we evaluate nine open and proprietary large language models and find that nearly all exhibit a systematic tendency to accept congruent evidence while resisting incongruent updates, with several models correctly identifying a weakening update yet failing to revise their conclusion. We believe our work and findings will facilitate future research on evaluating language models in defeasible reasoning.
2608.30413.paper_summary_zh: 可撤回推理是一種推理方式，其中根據可信的當前證據進行推斷，但在引入更新證據後可以撤回。雖然最近的研究已經考察了語言模型在可撤回推理中的行為，但數據集一直是靜態的，並且缺乏對非單調推理類別的廣泛覆蓋。我們介紹了DeReLab，一個生成框架，從參數化圖結構中生成多輪信念更新對話，涵蓋默認推理和繼承推理，並在每一輪提供正式驗證的真實數據，從而實現對模型如何對確認和否定證據作出反應的控制測量。這一受控生成過程為實驗設計創造了一個測試平台，以隔離特定的推理需求。將這一能力應用於確認偏誤的研究，我們評估了九個開放和專有的大型語言模型，發現幾乎所有模型都表現出系統性傾向，接受一致的證據，同時抵抗不一致的更新，其中幾個模型正確識別出弱化更新，但未能修正其結論。我們相信，我們的工作和發現將促進未來對可撤回推理中語言模型評估的研究。
